*Downloading tidyverse*
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
roundedNum = round(3.14159, digits = 2)
print(roundedNum)
```
```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))
print(rep(times = 2, x = 3))
```
```{r}
myNum = 12
myChar = "Hello world"
myLogic = FALSE

print(paste(myNum,", ", myChar,", ", myLogic))
print(paste(class(myNum), class(myChar), class(myLogic)))
```
Vector introduction:
```{r}
#Creating variables
numOne = 5415
numTwo = 8123
numThree = 1234
jointVector = c(numOne, numTwo, numThree)

#Printing vectors
print(jointVector)
print(paste("This is the 2nd number in my vector:", jointVector[3]))

#More vectors :|
allMyPets = c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
allMyPets[1] = "chinchilla"

for(item in allMyPets)
{
  print(item)
}
```

Data frames introduction:
```{r}
myDataFrame = tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)

print(myDataFrame)
gt(myDataFrame)
```

Weather CSV Task:
